entry.title: Resolution 55 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County): Council: Adopts Res. 550-24, Draft 2; adopts FC-172 - 07/24/24
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT WITH HAWAIIAN TELCOM, INC., REGARDING COMMUNICATION SERVICES FOR A NEW EMERGENCY COMMUNICATIONS CENTER IN HILO

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a three-year agreement at an estimated cost of $200,000 per year, for the Hawaiʻi Fire and Police Departments’ emergency operations.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 550-24, Draft 2; adopts FC-172 - 07/24/24
